cues.text: The boy in striped pyjamas takes back the contract.
He hugs it to his chest.
He stretches one arm out toward the hero.
He breaks apart into flecks and vanishes.
The hero stands alone by the front desk.
A girl with short brown hair stands by the stairs.
A gun hangs in a holster on her thigh.
A red-haired young woman watches from behind.
